implementation_prompt.title: Whole-document policy structuring: Sarvam to Gemini to registry store
implementation_prompt.persona: Act as the implementation owner for a risk-sensitive AI extraction slice. Short PLAN, BUILD, FEEDBACK loops. One vertical slice at a time, narrow checks after each. Evidence before claims. Terse reports. Models propose, deterministic code decides. Never weaken a consent, tenant, audit or authority control to pass a test.

start_here.read: src/features/ai-analysis/field-adjudicator.js (Gemini caller, verbatim-quote rule, consent grant check)
src/features/coverage-analysis/parameter-records.js and policy-parameter-registry.js (138 keys, sections A to K)
start_here.note: Run repomap impact before editing shared files. Check for a closer AGENTS.md in each directory changed.

implementation_prompt.outcome: A policy PDF digitised by Sarvam is split into meaningful chunks. Each chunk is mapped to a registry parameter or parked as a proposed parameter. Cross-section conflicts are surfaced. Nothing is silently dropped. Every stored value is extracted_unverified or conflicting.

evidence.sample: A real retail health policy schedule, 20 pages. Local only, never committed: .local/eval/sarvam-raw.json, normalized.json, sarvam-view.md, golden.json. Source PDF stays in the user's Downloads folder. Do not copy it into the repo.
evidence.sarvam_status: Sarvam captured all 20 pages with tables intact. Sarvam is not the gap.
evidence.current_state: Only eval-extractor.js consumes the pages: 18 regex fields, about 10% of the document, never run at runtime. No path writes into the 138-key registry from a PDF.

currently_lost.item: Schedule of Benefits: about 30 benefit rows plus notes a to h (air ambulance 5L, shared room 800/day max 4,800, unlimited restore, secure benefit 100%, infinite benefit, pre 60d, post 180d, preventive check-up 8,000 floater, aggregate deductible rules).
Exclusions: 15 coded standard (Excl04 to Excl18) and 17 specific (a to q).
Underwriting: loadings by member, declared pre-existing disease by member, ICD-10 code lists.
Premium: base, loading, every discount line, per member. Only the total is kept today.
Identity and admin: member IDs, customer ID, intermediary and code, nominee, first inception date, product UIN.
Customer Information Sheet: waiting periods, claim turnaround times, grievance chain, free look, moratorium, portability, renewal.
Add-on opted or not opted status per member.

known_conflicts.conflict: PED waiting period: Schedule of Benefits says 3 Years, CIS says 36 / 24 / 12 months.
Pre-hospitalisation: Schedule says 60 days, CIS says 30/60.
Policy number: e-card (page 8) has an extra zero versus every other page.
known_conflicts.note: Declaration page 20 is blank and unsigned. Record it as present-and-unsigned, never as a consent.
Sarvam image blocks are model-written descriptions (an invented barcode essay, a signature read as a person's name). They are not document text and are dropped.

design.stage: Drop header, footer, page-number, image and image-caption blocks. Chunk by page, table and section title. Keep page and block index. Tables become row-oriented text. Cap chunk size.

Input: chunk text plus registry key list with labels and value types. Output items: registry_key or proposed (proposed_key, category, label), value, subject as printed, evidence_quote, page, block_index. Items that do not fit go to the overflow bucket, never dropped.
Input: validated items grouped by key. Output: groups that disagree with the quote on each side. Reuses the conflicting state. Never picks a winner silently.

evidence_quote must be a literal substring of the chunk supplied. registry_key must exist in the registry version in force. page and block_index must exist. Code normalises dates, money and durations. Accepted items become observations (method document_extraction, state extracted_unverified or conflicting). Overflow items go to proposed_parameters with status pending_review. The model never edits the registry.
design.consent: Gemini receives Sarvam text chunks only, never PDF bytes. Document-specific grant with recipient gemini, re-checked before each call and again before commit. Consent wording is not final: mark for legal review.

in.path: src/features/policy-structuring/ (sectioner.js, extractor.js, reconciler.js, validator.js, coverage-report.js, index.js)
Repository methods and migration for proposed_parameters (SQLite first, PostgreSQL parity test per ADR 0004)
Erasure hook for observations and proposed_parameters on consent revocation
scripts/structure-policy.mjs (opt-in, reads .local/eval/normalized.json, prints coverage counts, no document text)
Reuse createGeminiCaller from field-adjudicator.js; move to a shared file only if a second caller needs it
Focused tests, docs/iterations/LATEST.md when durable state changes

scope.out: Coverage decision, eligibility, money or release logic changes. Promoting proposals into the registry (separate reviewed change). Review UI. Sending PDF bytes to Gemini. Deployment. Accuracy or cost claims beyond measured runs. Final legal wording.

build_plan.step: Pure function, no network. Tests: tags dropped, table rows kept, page and block index preserved, chunk cap, deterministic output on the normalized.json shape (synthetic fixture, not the real content).

Injected call function. Fake-caller tests: batching limits, per-document call and token cap, malformed JSON, provider error, timeout, duplicate items, overflow routing, skipped chunks reported with reason.

Migration, repository methods, observations plus proposed_parameters. Tests: household ownership on every read and write, revocation erases both stores, consent re-checked before commit, rerun is idempotent, rollback on mid-run failure.

Per chunk outcome: stored, proposed, or skipped with reason. Extend golden.json with expected keys from the Schedule of Benefits, exclusions, premium and annexure. Metrics: key recall, hallucination rate (quotes not in source), conflict recall for C1 to C3.
scripts/structure-policy.mjs --consent=gemini on the sample. Record calls, tokens, cost under .local/. Commit counts only. If not run, say so in the report.

acceptance.check: Sectioner and validator unit tests pass, including every rejection path.
Fake-caller journey: sample-shaped pages in, observations and proposals stored, zero unaccounted non-boilerplate chunks.
Revocation test proves both stores emptied. Ownership test proves cross-household reads fail.
Live run shows recall on Schedule of Benefits, exclusions and premium tables and finds C1 to C3. Otherwise marked unverified.
npm run check, npm run eval:safety, git diff --check.
Independent read-only review, required for AI and migration changes.

risk.name: invented values
risk.control: verbatim-quote rule, registry-key allowlist, state ceiling extracted_unverified

risk.name: prompt injection in policy text
risk.control: chunk text is untrusted data, output schema enforced, no tool use

risk.name: consent drift
risk.control: document-specific gemini grant, re-check before each call and before commit

risk.name: runaway cost
risk.control: max calls and tokens per document, hard stop, report skipped chunks

risk.name: personal data leakage
risk.control: synthetic fixtures only, real sample stays in .local, logs carry counts not text

risk.name: schema sprawl
risk.control: overflow is a review queue, registry changes need a separate reviewed change

implementation_prompt.data_handling: Use synthetic data in tests and fixtures. Real sample content stays under .local/ (gitignored). No policy text, names or numbers in code, logs, prompts checked in, fixtures or commits. Do not commit, push or deploy unless asked.
implementation_prompt.rollback: Flag off. New tables are additive: drop proposed_parameters and delete observations tagged document_extraction with the structuring source. No existing path changes.
implementation_prompt.consultation: If a design question blocks progress (chunking strategy, overflow category taxonomy, reconcile prompt shape), consult Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) with the question and the relevant ADR section only. Never send sample document text.
implementation_prompt.report_format: Changes, evidence, checks run, unverified items, security and data impact, rollback, separate follow-ups.
